params.body:
## Why

Deleting one vehicle from the own-stock list asked "Dit voertuig verwijderen?" with the line
"Ze verdwijnen meteen uit de lijst" underneath. Two things were wrong with that. The sentence
was plural over a single row, and the question named nothing: a dealer with four Golfs had no
way to check the question against the row he clicked, in front of an action he cannot undo.

The bulk delete had the mirror problem: it always said ":n wagens verwijderen?", so one ticked
row read "1 wagens verwijderen?".

Two of the keys involved (`delete_one_question`, `this_vehicle`) existed only in Dutch, so an
English, French, German or Spanish dealer got the raw key `vehicle.delete_one_question` printed
in the dialog. The same held for `vehicle.remove_photos` in English and Spanish.

## What the dialog says now

One vehicle, row action or a selection of one:

> **Volkswagen Golf Variant (2019) verwijderen?**
> Chassis WVWZZZ1KZAW123456. Verdwijnt meteen uit de lijst; dit kan niet ongedaan gemaakt worden.

Three vehicles:

> **3 voertuigen verwijderen?**
> Ze verdwijnen meteen uit de lijst; dit kan niet ongedaan gemaakt worden.

The name is make and model plus the build year, and the line under it carries the one detail
that tells two identical cars apart: the chassis number first, the internal number (the column
the list shows when the dealer uses them) when there is no chassis, and the vehicle id when
both are empty. There is no licence plate column on `vehicles`, so that chain is what the
sheet actually holds.

Both come from accessors on the model (`display_name`, `delete_label`, `identifying_detail`),
and the row prints its name through the same `display_name`, so the question cannot drift from
the row it is asked next to. The number comes from `trans_choice` with explicit `{1}` / `[2,*]`
ranges, which sidesteps the per-language plural rules; `App\Livewire\OwnStockList` exposes the
question and the hint as computed properties, so the blade holds no counting logic.

Nothing about what gets deleted changed: `deleteVehicle` and `deleteSelected` are untouched.

## Other call sites fixed and left

Fixed:

- **Own-stock bulk delete** (`livewire/own-stock-list.blade.php`) — always plural, never named.
- **Own-stock row delete** (`ownstock/_wagen_rij.blade.php`) — plural hint over one vehicle.
- **Photo bulk delete** (`_tabs/photos.blade.php`, `_tabs/photos/stocklist.blade.php`) —
  `vehicle.remove_photos` said "alle geselecteerde foto's" for a single ticked photo. The count
  is only known in the browser, so `vehicle.deleteSelected` now takes both forms and picks on
  the number of checked boxes, filling `:n`. Added the key to `en` and `es`, which lacked it.
- **Missing translations**: `delete_one_question` and `this_vehicle` added to `en`, `fr`, `de`,
  `es`; all plural sentences given both forms in all five languages.

Left alone, on purpose:

- `global.bentuzeker` ("Bent u zeker?") on release notes, roles, options, users, dealers,
  locations, useful links, requirements, `simple/index` and the worklist widgets. It is a vague
  question, but it has no number problem and each of those is a single-row action. Naming the
  record in those dialogs is a separate job.
- `global.lblItemVerwijderen` (offers, relations) — already singular and already names the item.
- `ui.delete_photo_confirm` ("Deze foto verwijderen?") and
  `global.delete_damage_confirm` / `delete_photo_extra_confirm` — already singular, and the
  damage one already names the location.
- `ui.clear_favorites_confirm` (stocklist browser) — a whole-list action, so the plural is right.
- `export.setwinner`, `export.setcontrolled`, `vehicle.setnotinoption`, the step buttons — single
  item, already singular.

## Checked

- `php artisan view:cache` plus `php -l` over every compiled view: clean.
- `npm run build`: clean (the JS change is in `resources/js/vehicle/vehicle.js`).
- `phpunit --filter='OwnStockList|VehicleSheet|VehicleForm|PhotoSelectAll|CompiledViews|UiApiUsage'`:
  45 tests, 277 assertions, green. Full suite: 543 tests, the only failure is `BuildStampTest`,
  which reads git metadata a worktree does not carry.
- Four new tests in `OwnStockListTest`: one vehicle is named and singular and carries its chassis
  number; three are counted and plural; a vehicle without a chassis number still gets identified
  by its internal number or its id; a vehicle without make or model has an empty label so the
  caller falls back cleanly.
- The dialog rendered at 1280 px for one and for three vehicles.
params.title: Deleting: say which vehicle, and in the right number
